## AI Review Queue
**Purpose:** validate explicit human approval/rejection before converting an AI suggestion.
**Input:** POST /webhook/pulse/admin/approve-suggestion.
**Output:** reviewed suggestion plus an auditable conversion payload.
**Credentials:** production requires admin JWT/Header Auth.
**Dependencies:** Data Sync persists the returned record/audit entry.
**Failure path:** no approval, reviewer or valid type means no state change.

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const suggestion=body.suggestion;const action=body.action;const approvedBy=String(body.approvedBy??'').trim().slice(0,120);const allowedTypes=new Set(['risk_zone','alert','incident','publication']);if(!suggestion?.id||!allowedTypes.has(suggestion.type)||!['approve','reject'].includes(action)||!approvedBy)return[{json:{ok:false,error:{code:'REVIEW_REQUIRED',message:'Se requiere una sugerencia válida, acción y revisor humano.'}}}];const approved=action==='approve';const reviewed={...suggestion,reviewStatus:approved?'approved':'rejected',reviewedAt:new Date().toISOString(),reviewedBy:approvedBy,humanApproved:approved};const result=approved?{id:`reviewed-${suggestion.id}`,type:suggestion.type,title:String(suggestion.title??'').slice(0,180),description:String(suggestion.description??'').slice(0,1000),location:suggestion.location,source:'ai_reviewed',sourceSuggestionId:suggestion.id,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}:null;const audit={timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),workflow:'PULSE — AI Review Queue',action, inputIds:[suggestion.id],model:suggestion.model??'deterministic',confidence:suggestion.confidence??null,humanApproved:approved,approvedBy,resultId:result?.id??null};return[{json:{ok:true,reviewed,result,audit,requiresPersistence:true}}];
